messages:
zoe (devex): Heads up: our quickstart edge sample failed during deployment with 'Unexpected token export' — local pnpm workspace runs fine. any yarn/pnpm workspaces gotchas we should document?
sam (pkg-maintainer): that smell is usually bad exports + missing esm artifact in the published tarball. pnpm symlinks hide the problem locally.
arpit (eng-runtime): +1. Edge optimizers expect ESM. If package.exports doesn't provide an explicit import conditional, bundlers may resolve the cjs path.
lee (ts): TS caveat: in a monorepo, editor resolves through the symlinked source, but consumers installing from registry see the built artifacts. So types can appear fine locally but break for downstream users.
zoe (devex): i'm seeing package.json had "./*": "./dist/cjs/*" and ".": "./dist/cjs/index.js" — oops.
sam (pkg-maintainer): yep that's the problematic pattern. Wildcard subpath mapping overrides conditional exports. Change root to conditional mapping: {"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"} and avoid wildcard for subpaths.
arpit (eng-runtime): also ensure the published tarball includes dist/esm. Quick CI job: npm pack -> tar -tf -> rg 'dist/esm' and fail if missing. pnpm's hoist layout can make local smoke tests misleading.
lee (ts): typing fix: make sure "types" points to the same surfaced entry (dist/esm/index.d.ts) and include a "./package.json" export so tools can read metadata.
zoe (devex): any shortterm app-side workarounds if we can't publish right away?
arpit (eng-runtime): app bundler tweak: prefer resolve.mainFields = ['exports','module','main'] or configure the optimizer to treat 'import' conditionals first. If using webpack, set mainFields accordingly. But that's brittle.
sam (pkg-maintainer): temporary hack: republish a patch that only includes the esm entry and correct exports. Longer term: add a prepublish-check script and a PR checklist for package owners.
ci-bot: CI/pack check failed for package-foo@0.4.1: dist/esm missing -> blocking merge.
zoe (devex): created PR template checklist: build esm, conditional exports, types adjacent to esm, verify tarball. adding a small troubleshooting blurb in the sample-app README about pnpm hoisting vs publish-time artifacts.
lee (ts): one more developer tip: run 'node --preserve-symlinks ./scripts/pack-and-test.js' in CI to mirror install-from-registry resolution if you need to catch these earlier.
arpit (eng-runtime): and note for yarn users: yarn classic hoists differently; still the root cause is incorrect exports. Fix upstream exports and you're golden.
zoe (devex): thanks all — deploying fixed package now, will follow up with a short post in #devex about the checklist. :white_check_mark:
